statements.statement: CPT 93271 was denied under CO-97 as bundled into another covered procedure
The clinical indication note documents recurrent palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
The symptoms are poorly correlated with standard 24-hour Holter monitoring results
The patient has a history of unspecified atrial fibrillation and cardiac arrhythmia
The diagnosis codes are I48.91 and I49.9
Prolonged cardiac event monitoring is indicated to capture intermittent symptomatic episodes and guide further rhythm management
